title: The owner's ten notes on the by-size build: soft tiers hunt the nearest of tank or gate, small Reeds from sector 2 rammable only at 120 km/h, the cored tiers slower and more opaque with longer seeking appendages, the shell's blast with a floor, hard cores hot on the thermals, the hull's health on its levitator, a white does a tenth to the heart
context: Owner, 2026-10-16, on 06ca7531: '1) first-wave ivories emerge from the ground, should come from the sinkhole; 2) ivories/lemons hunting logic: rush whichever is closest, tank if tank, gate if gate; 3) lemons correctly afraid of mortar; 4) from sector 2 introduce a few small Reeds, rammable only at high speed, say 120; 5) purple hard-core less transparent, slower, longer appendages seeking before moving, same brown and black; black only a few at a time, much stronger, biggest, slow and deliberate; 6) tank shell AOE more impactful, not just direct hits; 7) packs of 5 and 3 lemons walking to the base look odd: IF creatures FEWER than 100 THEN split packs; 8) hard cores more distinct on gunship thermals; 9) Mork 4 hits: diegetic health on the cyan energy levitator; 10) small ivories do 1/10th damage to the heart.'
outcome: STORY_FODDER.headStart null (the first wave rises at the sinkhole, not up the lane). PEARL_HUNT { tiers white and yellow, within 10 }: a soft body within ten hops of the hull rushes it, else the gate (src/fx/enemy-step.js wantsTank; the hunters' field is computed while any hunter or soft hunter lives). HUNTERS.from 2; the small Reed's ramAt 120 (CREATURE_TIERS.reed.small; the ram checks hullKmh). Purple, brown and black: membraneOpacity 0.5, cycles 5 / 4.5 / 4, reach 1.35, caps 0.7 / 0.6 / 0.5 radii a second; black 1.3 in size, 1.8 in hit points, at most three a pulse. SHELL_BLAST { radius 3, peak 4.5, floor 0.45 }: any body inside the blast takes at least the floor's share of the peak (the peak must stay under 5 for the shell-blast test). creatureEnemies.thermal(on): under the gunship's FLIR the cored pools' membranes and cores run a white emissive (1.4), the soft tiers stay cold; off when the seat is left. HEALTH_STOPS: the levitator's glow cyan at four hits, darker blue at three, orange at two, red at one (hullArmour / hullHits). PEARL heart damage: white 0.1. SQUADS.unpackUnder 100.
alternatives: A HUD bar for the hull's hits: the owner asked for it on the body ('diegetic'); the console keeps the pips as the readout.
Blue thermals for the soft tiers: the cored ones hot and the rest cold already reads at a glance on the FLIR's palette.
evidence: test/pearl-enemies.mjs (opacity, cycles, hp, heartDmg), test/shell-blast.mjs, test/hull-armour.mjs, test/body-footprint.mjs, test/enemy-step.mjs
